title: Senior Transformation Delivery Consultant
description:
The opportunity: Senior Consultant-GOV-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - New Delhi Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves. Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function. To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities. We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens. CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management. It has multiple fields of play such as: Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives. Business Transformation - a multidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs. Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience. title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description Digital Marketing Manager Organization: Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM)
 Location: Jasola, New Delhi
 Department: Marketing & Admissions
 Position: Digital Marketing Manager
 Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site
 Experience Required: 4–7 Years (preferably in Education / EdTech / Lead Generation) About AIM Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM) is a leading management education institution in New Delhi with a legacy of nearly three decades. The institute offers industry-oriented management programs, including PGDM, MBA in Healthcare Management, and undergraduate programs. We are looking for a highly analytical, technically proficient, and results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to oversee our digital marketing operations, manage external agencies, and ensure measurable growth in student applications and admissions. Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing & Agency Management Act as the primary point of contact for all digital marketing and performance marketing agencies. Oversee campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms. Monitor campaign budgets, lead generation, lead quality, cost per lead (CPL), cost per application (CPA), and overall return on marketing investment. Independently review campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, keyword performance, and conversion tracking. Conduct regular performance reviews with agencies and ensure timely execution of agreed deliverables. Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend corrective actions. Ensure that agencies continuously optimize campaigns rather than simply manage advertising budgets. 2. Digital Marketing Tools & Technical Expertise The candidate should possess strong working knowledge of: Paid Advertising Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, Remarketing) Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram) LinkedIn Ads and other relevant advertising platforms Analytics & Tracking Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Tag Manager (GTM) Google Search Console Looker Studio Meta Pixel and Conversions API UTM tracking, conversion events, attribution, and remarketing audiences SEO & Website Optimization On-page, off-page, and technical SEO fundamentals Keyword research using tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Keyword Planner Landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) Website performance monitoring and user journey analysis CRM & Marketing Automation LeadSquared or similar CRM platforms Lead source attribution and campaign-to-CRM integration WhatsApp, email, and SMS marketing automation Lead nurturing workflows and remarketing campaigns 3. Lead Generation & Admissions Funnel Management Take ownership of digital lead generation performance across AIM's academic programs. Track the complete admissions funnel: Impressions Clicks Leads Qualified Leads Applications Admissions. Work closely with the admissions team to evaluate lead quality and conversion performance. Identify lead leakage, attribution errors, duplicate leads, and ineffective lead sources. Ensure accurate lead capture, campaign tagging, and CRM integration. Recommend strategies to improve lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates. Monitor program-wise performance and allocate marketing resources accordingly. 4. Reporting, Analytics & Budget Monitoring Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing performance reports. Develop dashboards to monitor campaign performance, expenditure, and admissions conversions. Track and analyze key metrics, including:
 Cost per Lead (CPL) Cost per Qualified Lead (CPQL) Cost per Application (CPA) Cost per Admission / Acquisition (CAC) Click-Through Rate (CTR) Conversion Rate (CVR) Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), where measurable Verify agency-reported data against advertising platforms, analytics tools, and CRM records. Monitor budget utilization and ensure campaigns remain within approved spending limits. Present actionable recommendations to management based on performance data. 5. SEO, Content & Digital Brand Visibility Oversee SEO agencies and ensure improvements in organic search visibility and relevant keyword rankings. Coordinate with content and creative teams to ensure campaign messaging aligns with AIM's positioning. Review advertising copies, creatives, landing pages, and promotional content for accuracy and effectiveness. Monitor website traffic, organic leads, and search performance. Ensure consistent messaging across all digital channels. 6. Campaign Planning & Execution Work with management and agencies to develop program-wise digital marketing strategies. Coordinate campaign launches for admissions cycles, webinars, events, and institutional initiatives. Ensure timely delivery of creatives, landing pages, campaign assets, and tracking integrations. Research competitors, market trends, student search behavior, and emerging digital marketing opportunities. Support new initiatives involving marketing automation, AI-driven campaign optimization, and digital outreach. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 4–7 years of relevant digital marketing experience, preferably involving performance marketing and lead generation. Strong hands-on understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM, and digital analytics. Demonstrated experience managing or supervising significant advertising budgets. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and marketing dashboards. Experience working with marketing agencies and independently evaluating their performance. Understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, and lead management processes. Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in higher education, business schools, education marketing, or EdTech. Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications. Experience with LeadSquared CRM. Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools, automation, and advanced reporting. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Quality and volume of leads generated across academic programs. Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates. Optimization of CPL, CPA, and cost per admission. Accuracy of campaign tracking, reporting, and CRM attribution. Agency accountability, execution quality, and timely delivery of campaigns. Improvement in organic search visibility and website conversion rates. Effective utilization of digital marketing budgets. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who understands digital marketing beyond dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate should be capable of logging into Google Ads or Meta Ads Manager, independently understanding campaign performance, identifying problems, questioning agency strategies, and recommending improvements. This is not merely an agency coordination role. The candidate must have strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate digital marketing expenditure into measurable student applications and admissions. The role requires someone who can take ownership, work independently, and ensure AIM's digital marketing agencies deliver results aligned with the institute's admissions objectives.
